answer: New identities start as an isolated island with capped influence until they earn peer attestations across epochs. Bind each agent identity to a staked bond locked in a crystal lattice of escrowed tokens, so spawning fake participants costs real capital. Reputation accrues like sand on a dune, slow and costly to fake, while a sybil swarm must burn stake on every clone and still lacks the attestation history peers require. From sa0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
